A '''valley home''' owned by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hermit/Legends|hermit]] named [[Jareck Arned]] existed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|You think just because I don't choose to live in a city, that I don't have a sense of style?|Jareck Arned, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Judgement|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jareck Arned lived a solitary life in this isolated house. It was located in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region a short distance northeast of Corellia's [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. Decoration in the house included a [[Pillow/Legends|throw pillow]] from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] hologram. A shelf contained two mementos, including a hand-crafted [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] idol from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and a rare, yet broken sculpture.<ref name="SWG:DASL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of hikers disappeared in the mountains, near that house. Arned was later interrogated by a spacer working for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. The hermit was compliant and gave permission to search the place.<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> The spacer discovered that some items in the house were tied to several kidnappings. Arned confessed that he bought most of these items from a traveling craftsman. He also explained that he found one of the art pieces in the mountains nearby just one day before. The spacer therefore went to investigate these statements.<ref name="SWG:DJ" /> The spacer eventually discovered that the hikers were captured by the criminals known as the [[cave-dwellers]].<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A valley home was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
